name: Chrysler Building
description: Chrysler Building: A skyscraper located in the eastern part of Manhattan, New York. It was commissioned by Walter P. Chrysler, the founder of the American Chrysler Manufacturing Company. It is 320 meters tall and has 77 floors. It was declared a U.S. national monument in 1976. The building's distinctive decoration was used on Chrysler automobiles as a sign of its illustrious automobile manufacturing empire, and the building's spire adorns the hubcap, which is considered a masterpiece of Art Deco architecture.
